title: Bale trailer
description: Blue flatbed hay trailer on two lugged yellow-rimmed wheels: a wooden plank deck at BALETRAILER.bed.top, low side rails on stakes, a planked headboard at the front, an A-frame tongue to the hitch eye with a jack stand, mudguard arcs in front of and behind each tyre, and a tow pin at the back. No grain node: the game draws round bales on the deck from Socket_Bed. Material `paint` is repainted per player.
checks: LEFT tile: a long flat deck with a tall headboard at the front end, the tongue reaching forward to the hitch eye, both wheels on the grid line
LEFT tile: the mudguard arcs sit in front of and behind the tyre with a gap to it; the tyre top stays under the deck
3/4 tile: a planked wooden deck with low blue rails along both edges, open at the back
BACK tile: the tow pin low in the middle, red tail lights, both tyres under the deck's edges
TOP tile: the deck is a clear flat rectangle for two bales across and two along
